subject: AWS Marketplace launch: risk playbook, evidence handoff, and field-ready kit
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@dataatlas.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@dataatlas.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace launch: copy + evidence checklist

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at DataAtlas is excited to move toward a Marketplace listing. We're targeting an internal sales kickoff for 11/10 and would like the listing live two weeks before that, if possible.

Before we start the AMI upload and product page, procurement asked for a concise list of evidence and claims we need to include for the listing (SOC2 evidence, data retention text, encryption at rest notes, and any tested latency claims). Can you share a one-page checklist and a short product-page copy snippet we can review with our legal team?

Also: we want a couple of Copilot-style sample prompts (to show buyers how to use the product) — low-effort ones that sales can demo in the kickoff.

Timeline: if we can get the checklist + copy by EOD 10/12 that would keep our launch schedule intact.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of GTM, DataAtlas
Lina Park | DataAtlas | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment: RFP_SLA_DA_2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@dataatlas.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: copy + evidence checklist

Hi Lina — great to hear and thanks for the clear timeline.

I've attached our "marketplace_evidence_checklist.xlsx" and a short "copilot_sample_prompts.md" with 3 starter prompts you can drop into the listing demo. High level:
- SOC 2: provide SOC 2 type II report (or SOC 2 letter) + date range
- Data handling: single-paragraph data retention + PII handling text (we'll provide a template)
- Encryption: note AES-256 at rest + TLS1.2+ in transit wording
- Performance claims: please give us expected median latency for 1k token inference on your test workload so we can surface it on the product page (we'll attribute to your test harness)

Marissa — can you pluck a 2–3 sentence hero and a 3-bullet feature list from the product_page_copy_v1.docx and drop final copy here? Need something tight for the marketplace hero and the short description.

Lina — attaching the checklist now (stubbed) and a small prompts file. If you want, we can run a quick screen-share on 10/12 AM to finalize language.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
T: +1 650-555-0124
[Attachment: marketplace_evidence_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: copilot_sample_prompts.md (text)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@dataatlas.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 15:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: copy + evidence checklist

Thanks — looked through the draft product copy. Lina, below are suggested edits for the hero + short description (inline for speed):

--- Suggested hero (2 sentences):
DataAtlas Insights on AWS Marketplace — Real-time semantic search and retriever augmentation for enterprise content. Reduce time-to-answer across docs, tickets, and knowledge bases with a single API and pre-built connectors.

--- Short description (3 bullets):
• Fast, low-latency semantic search optimized for long documents (quantization-ready).
• Deployable through AWS Marketplace AMI or container — single-click onboarding for enterprise trials.
• SOC 2 compliant with configurable data residency and KMS integrations.

Minor: change "quantization-ready" to "quantization-friendly" in the hero for accuracy. Also: can you confirm which SKUs you'll offer for the privateoffer/trial? We need SKU names to map entitlement and trial durations.

I'll update the product_page_copy_v1.docx and attach a cleaned copy for Marissa to extract final hero + bullets.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: product_page_copy_v1.docx (docx)]

Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: copy + evidence checklist

Hi Lina — quick update after our internal sync.

1) We've uploaded a draft product_page_copy (attached) with Kim's edits and two hero variations. Marissa picked Variation B as the succinct hero for Marketplace.
2) Procurement: please send the SOC 2 letter and an FAQ-style paragraph for data retention; we'll push both to the Marketplace listing and into the offer tile.
3) SKUs/trials: to avoid entitlement gaps we suggest: DA-TRIAL-1 (14-day, 10 seats), DA-STD-1 (monthly metered), DA-ENT-1 (annual reserved). If that matches your pricing model we can pre-populate the PrivateOffer fields.
4) DocuSign: here's the DocuSign link for the marketplace terms + privateoffer addendum: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/abc123 — we can route countersignature after you sign.

If you sign by EOD 10/13 we'll be able to hit the 10/27 soft-go-live window for the field kickoff on 11/10. Want to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow at 10am PT to finish the hero and confirm SKUs?

Best,
Sean
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 650-555-0124
